name: Brother Ephilates

bonuses.name: Architect of Ruin
bonuses.text: The GM gains 1 point of Ruin at the start of each of Brother Ephilates turns.

bonuses.name: Champion
bonuses.text: Brother Ephilates may use Ruin actions and has 2 personal Ruin.

bonuses.name: Space Marine Implants
bonuses.text: Brother Ephilates gains bonus dice and options for actions from Space Marine Implants (W&G Core Rulebook p.75)

abilities.name: Staff of Possession
abilities.text: Spend 1 Ruin. Brother Ephilates may choose a target within 20m with the <PSYKER> Keyword. The Target must pass a DN2 Psychic Mastery(Wil) Test, if failed the target must immediately roll on the Perils of the Warp table (W&G Core Rulebook p. 263).

abilities.name: Veteran of the Long War
abilities.text: Spend 1 Ruin. Add the game's Tier as ED to all attacks Brother Ephilates makes this Round.

note: The Determination line prints before the Reaction in the book.
